correctness.rationale: For each of n=5,6,7 all 2^binom(n,2)-1 possible nonempty faces are tested by two independent exact predicates, giving face counts 85, 405, 1911. Each explicitly constructed matching is checked acyclic on the entire Hasse graph (180,1155,6405 directed incidences), with critical cells (1,6), (1,0,24,10), (1,0,8,408). Signed recursive Morse boundaries agree entry-by-entry with an independent integer Schur-complement cancellation using only pivots ±1. All critical degrees vanish for n=5,6. At n=7 the 8-by-408 critical degree-three boundary contains an explicit 8-by-8 determinant -1 minor. The CW attaching classes lie in pi_2 of a wedge of two-spheres, identified with integral degrees by Hurewicz; unimodular cancellation proves the 400-sphere wedge. The full checker and deterministic recorded output are embedded.

originality.rationale: The same object is called Ind_2(T_n), the P_3-devoid complex D(T_n;P_3), or the complex of edge selections in K_n with each nonempty chosen-edge component a single edge or two-edge path. Taylan (2015) treats P_3-devoid constructions but computes paths, cycles and forests; Deshpande–Singh (2020) studies higher independence but computes multipartite, whiskered, paths/cycles and perfect trees. The canonical triangular graphs are none of those covered families. Published nearby triangular-graph neighborhood and four-cut results use different face conditions. Actual source, parameter and claim comparisons to indexed records did not reveal a statement implying this exact integral 5–7 classification, with reasonable residual risk of unindexed equivalent computations.

value.rationale: The line graph of a complete graph is a canonical, maximally symmetric family. Its 2-independence complex naturally encodes disjoint selected edges and two-edge paths, the first relaxation beyond ordinary matchings. At six underlying points two disjoint length-two paths first fit, and this yields an exact nonpure complex with integral reduced homology of ranks 24 in degree 2 and 10 in degree 3. At seven points the complex becomes pure and an explicit integral determinant-one attaching map removes every degree-2 class; all 400 remaining degree-3 spheres are classified. The three-point transition provides a concrete structural comparison and reproducible mixed-dimensional boundary with a plausible role as an initial benchmark; it is not an arbitrary graph slice or merely a finite-field table.
